description:
Check every number in a draft against the filing characters it cites, and link them.

Write your draft with a citation right after each figure, using the ref that
list_figures or verify_figure gave for it:
    revenue of $68.1 billion [ref:0001045810-26-000019/q4fy26pr.htm@112+4]
For a number you calculated, cite its inputs:
    up 73% [calc: ref:<current>, ref:<prior>]
A ref names the exact characters in the document: <accession>/<filename>@<start>+<len>.

Returns per citation: ok / rounded (your number is the cited figure times a power of
ten, rounded), mismatch (the cited characters are a different number), bad_ref (no
number at that position), not_derivable (no sum, difference, ratio or growth rate of
the inputs gives your number). unsourced_numbers lists figures with no citation. Fix
every failure before presenting the text, then use linked_text and footnotes: each
footnote links to the highlighted figure in the filing, so a reader can check it.

Args:
    text: The draft, with [ref:…] / [calc: …] citations (max ~200 KB)
name: check_citations
title: Check Citations in a Draft
